applies_to.package: post-READY cover-route revocation / visual admission R&D

subject: FINDING: exact cover readiness can revoke to WAITING while visual authority remains admitted
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-research-rd-1-readiness-revocation-20261002. CURRENT MAIN=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. Confirmed source integration gap: Fold7CoverReadiness.observe() correctly downgrades READY->WAITING_ROUTE when exact topology/route proof is lost, but Fold7ContinuityCoordinator.visualMirrorActive is only mirrorRequested && COVER_VISUAL. onTopologyFastLane repairs when readiness is not READY but does not revoke an already-attached visual host; syncMirrorHost returns on missing active topology before detaching the old host. Prior CoverReadiness R&D explicitly required route-drop while visible to hide local mirror state, retain demand, repair, then re-show. Staged Gen3 Alpha1 also carries the boundary forward: apply script passes demand-only continuity.visualMirrorActive as closingVisible, and Fold7Gen3VisualCoordinator host binding does not consume the exact Fold7CoverReadiness demand/token. Recommended invariant: semantic visual demand may stay latched, but host admission must require exact current readiness READY; READY->WAITING revokes host, and only fresh current READY can create a new host/attempt. research-rd-7 owns Display.STATE renderability predicate; this work consumes its readiness outcome. No production writes.

artifacts.purpose: full source reconstruction, staged Gen3 reconciliation, design, regression and field plan
